verses.ar: فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ يُغَنَّى بِهَذِهِ ٱلْأُغْنِيَّةِ فِي أَرْضِ يَهُوذَا: لَنَا مَدِينَةٌ قَوِيَّةٌ. يَجْعَلُ ٱلْخَلَاصَ أَسْوَارًا وَمَتْرَسَةً.
verses.kjv: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will [God] appoint [for] walls and bulwarks.
verses.web: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

verses.ar: اِفْتَحُوا ٱلْأَبْوَابَ لِتَدْخُلَ ٱلْأُمَّةُ ٱلْبَارَّةُ ٱلْحَافِظَةُ ٱلْأَمَانَةَ.
verses.kjv: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
verses.web: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.

verses.ar: ذُو ٱلرَّأْيِ ٱلْمُمَكَّنِ تَحْفَظُهُ سَالِمًا سَالِمًا، لِأَنَّهُ عَلَيْكَ مُتَوَكِّلٌ.
verses.kjv: Thou wilt keep [him] in perfect peace, [whose] mind [is] stayed [on thee:] because he trusteth in thee.
verses.web: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

verses.ar: تَوَكَّلُوا عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ، لِأَنَّ فِي يَاهَ ٱلرَّبِّ صَخْرَ ٱلدُّهُورِ.
verses.kjv: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH [is] everlasting strength:
verses.web: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ يَخْفِضُ سُكَّانَ ٱلْعَلَاءِ، يَضَعُ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ ٱلْمُرْتَفِعَةَ. يَضَعُهَا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ. يُلْصِقُهَا بِٱلتُّرَابِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, [even] to the ground; he bringeth it [even] to the dust.
verses.web: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.

verses.ar: تَدُوسُهَا ٱلرِّجْلُ، رِجْلَا ٱلْبَائِسِ، أَقْدَامُ ٱلْمَسَاكِينِ.
verses.kjv: The foot shall tread it down, [even] the feet of the poor, [and] the steps of the needy.
verses.web: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”

verses.ar: طَرِيقُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ ٱسْتِقَامَةٌ. تُمَهِّدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمُ سَبِيلَ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ.
verses.kjv: The way of the just [is] uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
verses.web: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

verses.ar: فَفِي طَرِيقِ أَحْكَامِكَ يَارَبُّ ٱنْتَظَرْنَاكَ. إِلَى ٱسْمِكَ وَإِلَى ذِكْرِكَ شَهْوَةُ ٱلنَّفْسِ.
verses.kjv: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of [our] soul [is] to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
verses.web: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

verses.ar: بِنَفْسِي ٱشْتَهَيْتُكَ فِي ٱللَّيْلِ. أَيْضًا بِرُوحِي فِي دَاخِلِي إِلَيْكَ أَبْتَكِرُ. لِأَنَّهُ حِينَمَا تَكُونُ أَحْكَامُكَ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ يَتَعَلَّمُ سُكَّانُ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ ٱلْعَدْلَ.
verses.kjv: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments [are] in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
verses.web: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

verses.ar: يُرْحَمُ ٱلْمُنَافِقُ وَلَا يَتَعَلَّمُ ٱلْعَدْلَ. فِي أَرْضِ ٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ يَصْنَعُ شَرًّا وَلَا يَرَى جَلَالَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, [yet] will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
verses.web: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، ٱرْتَفَعَتْ يَدُكَ وَلَا يَرَوْنَ. يَرَوْنَ وَيَخْزَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْرَةِ عَلَى ٱلشَّعْبِ وَتَأْكُلُهُمْ نَارُ أَعْدَائِكَ.
verses.kjv: LORD, [when] thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: [but] they shall see, and be ashamed for [their] envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
verses.web: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، تَجْعَلُ لَنَا سَلَامًا لِأَنَّكَ كُلَّ أَعْمَالِنَا صَنَعْتَهَا لَنَا.
verses.kjv: ¶ LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
verses.web: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.

verses.ar: أَيُّهَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُنَا، قَدِ ٱسْتَوْلَى عَلَيْنَا سَادَةٌ سِوَاكَ. بِكَ وَحْدَكَ نَذْكُرُ ٱسْمَكَ.
verses.kjv: O LORD our God, [other] lords beside thee have had dominion over us: [but] by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
verses.web: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.

verses.ar: هُمْ أَمْوَاتٌ لَا يَحْيَوْنَ. أَخْيِلَةٌ لَا تَقُومُ. لِذَلِكَ عَاقَبْتَ وَأَهْلَكْتَهُمْ وَأَبَدْتَ كُلَّ ذِكْرِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: [They are] dead, they shall not live; [they are] deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
verses.web: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.

verses.ar: زِدْتَ ٱلْأُمَّةَ يَارَبُّ، زِدْتَ ٱلْأُمَّةَ. تَمَجَّدْتَ. وَسَّعْتَ كُلَّ أَطْرَافِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed [it] far [unto] all the ends of the earth.
verses.web: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ فِي ٱلضِّيقِ طَلَبُوكَ. سَكَبُوا مُخَافَتَةً عِنْدَ تَأْدِيبِكَ إِيَّاهُمْ.
verses.kjv: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer [when] thy chastening [was] upon them.
verses.web: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.

verses.ar: كَمَا أَنَّ ٱلْحُبْلَى ٱلَّتِي تُقَارِبُ ٱلْوِلَادَةَ تَتَلَوَّى وَتَصْرُخُ فِي مَخَاضِهَا، هَكَذَا كُنَّا قُدَّامَكَ يَارَبُّ.
verses.kjv: Like as a woman with child, [that] draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, [and] crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
verses.web: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, Yahweh.

verses.ar: حَبِلْنَا تَلَوَّيْنَا كَأَنَّنَا وَلَدْنَا رِيحًا. لَمْ نَصْنَعْ خَلَاصًا فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَلَمْ يَسْقُطْ سُكَّانُ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ.
verses.kjv: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.web: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance on the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

verses.ar: تَحْيَا أَمْوَاتُكَ، تَقُومُ ٱلْجُثَثُ. ٱسْتَيْقِظُوا، تَرَنَّمُوا يَا سُكَّانَ ٱلتُّرَابِ. لِأَنَّ طَلَّكَ طَلُّ أَعْشَابٍ، وَٱلْأَرْضُ تُسْقِطُ ٱلْأَخْيِلَةَ.
verses.kjv: Thy dead [men] shall live, [together with] my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew [is as] the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
verses.web: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.

verses.ar: هَلُمَّ يَا شَعْبِي ٱدْخُلْ مَخَادِعَكَ، وَأَغْلِقْ أَبْوَابَكَ خَلْفَكَ. ٱخْتَبِئْ نَحْوَ لُحَيْظَةٍ حَتَّى يَعْبُرَ ٱلْغَضَبُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
verses.web: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ هُوَذَا ٱلرَّبُّ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ لِيُعَاقِبَ إِثْمَ سُكَّانِ ٱلْأَرْضِ فِيهِمْ، فَتَكْشِفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ دِمَاءَهَا وَلَا تُغَطِّي قَتْلَاهَا فِي مَا بَعْدُ.
verses.kjv: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
verses.web: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
